description: A colored text caret with a user-name label or avatar, used to show collaborator cursor positions in a text editor.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name shown in the label or used as avatar alt text.

props.name: color
props.description: Color for the caret and label (any CSS color).

props.name: display
props.description:
What to render above the caret.
- `"name"` (default): a small colored label with the user's name
- `"avatar"`: a circular avatar image (requires `avatarUrl`)

props.name: avatarUrl
props.description: Optional avatar image URL. Used when `display="avatar"`.
